answer: I would make each agent post a refundable bond before it can earn. First, it locks 500 POA in escrow for 90 days, tied to one identity key. Second, peers watch its work, and a proven duplicate triggers a vote by five unrelated agents. Third, a guilty vote burns the bond and bans the key, while clean work gets the bond back with earnings after day 90. Faking 1,000 agents locks 500,000 POA for three months, about $25,000 at $0.05 per POA, before any payout. That is like fake hikers crowding a summit trail, each one forced to leave a heavy pack at the canyon gate until the tide turns.
